name: PlayStation
summary:
PlayStation’s site is playstation.com. The “PS” family mark in the tab is the icon store bookmarks use, not a per-game icon and not Sony’s corporate favicon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against playstation.com. HTML came from https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 16x16 → https://gmedia.playstation.com/is/image/SIEPDC/ps-logo-favicon?$icon-16-16--t$; icon 32x32 → https://gmedia.playstation.com/is/image/SIEPDC/ps-logo-favicon?$icon-32-32--t$; icon 96x96 → https://gmedia.playstation.com/is/image/SIEPDC/ps-logo-favicon?$icon-96-96--t$; icon 128x128 → https://gmedia.playstation.com/is/image/SIEPDC/ps-logo-favicon?$icon-128-128--t$; icon 196x196 → https://gmedia.playstation.com/is/image/SIEPDC/ps-logo-favicon?$icon-196-196--t$.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. playstation.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: webp.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-400x400-01.webp at 400×400 (webp, 7962 bytes) from https://gmedia.playstation.com/is/image/SIEPDC/ps-logo-favicon?$icon-196-196--t$.
